node.title: Re^6: How to extract a pattern in Perl regex?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I find myself more often writing programs that just aren't practical as one liners

Same here. My reaction was inspired by [id://11116296|this]: 'However part of my question was how do I extract in one statement what's in between the "title tags". ... Surely there's a simpler way?' I think one of the things that turns people off from using modules instead of plain regexes is because modules often require a lot of boilerplate, which luckily [mod://Mojolicious] for the most part does not.
